test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Proficient
solution:
The correct answer is **Accomplished.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proficient **refers to knowledgeable and skilled. 

 
 
• **Example: ***She is very proficient in the French language. *
 
 
 
• **Accomplished** refers to someone who is exceptionally good at anything.
 
 
• **Example: ***He is among the most accomplished alumni of the school.*
 
 
 
• **"**Proficient**" **and** "**Accomplished**"** are similar in meaning. 

Therefore, the correct option is Accomplished.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dominant** refers to someone stronger, more significant, or more obvious than others.
 
• **Modest** refers to something which is not pricey or excessively vast in scale.
 
• **Predictable** means something was anticipated to occur or was likely to.
